main_text.p: עלומים m.p. Adolescentia, pars aetatis Occulta, cum ad officia publica raro adhibeatur: Aff. עלומיו Adolescentia ejus, Psal.89.46. עלומנו Occulta nostra, Psal.90.8. id est, Peccata adolescentiae nostrae, quae nobis sunt incognita & Occulta: עלומיו Peccato adolescentiae ejus, Job.20.11. עלומיך Adolescentia tua, Jesa.54.4.
תעלומה f. Absconditum, Job.28.11. Plural. תעלומות Abscondita, Psalm.44.22.

עולם m. Seculum, Tempus hominis Absconditum, tam infinitum & aeternum, quàm finitum, ut Gen.17.8. Exo.21.6. 1.Sam.1.22. & 13.13. 2.Sam.12.10. &c. מן העולם A seculo, id est, Jam olim, לעולם In seculum, Exod.21.6. Aff. עולמו Seculi sui, Eccles.12.5. Plurale, עולמים Secula, 1.Regum 8.13. לעולמים In secula, Eccles.1.10. Constructum, עד־עולמי עד Usque ad secula aeternitatis, Jesa.45. v.17. עולם Est spatium 50. annorum, Raschi ad Exod.21.6. Vide & Aben Efram.
עלם Chald. Seculum: ולחי עלמא Et viventem in perpetuum, Dan.4.31. Plur. לעלמין In secula, Dan.5.10. & לעלמיא Dan.2.44.
עילום m. Idem: לעילום In seculum, 2.Par.33.7.

על־מות לבן Psalm.49.15. vide in מות: At illius R.Salomon tam varias Hebraeorum interpretationes citat, ut adduci hoc loco omnes non possint, sed difficile optimam eligere. Incertae sunt omnes. Haec vocabula, ut alia plura in titulis Psalmorum, Hebraeis ipsis nondum satis explorata sunt. Vide supra in בין.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points are not reliably legible at this scan resolution, so the Hebrew headwords and forms are given as consonants only. The first Hebrew headword in the entry "עלומים" has a printed symbol before it that I could not identify and left out. "Abscondituum" in the entry for תעלומה is probably a printing error for "Absconditum" but I transcribed it as printed. The Hebrew phrase "לבן" in the last entry sits beside "At illius" and its placement may be off. The word "Aff." and the Hebrew bullet-like marks are as seen. The running head is a single Hebrew word, "על".
